panels.headline: GraphRAG enhances LLMs' social responsibility and performance.
content: RAG improves downstream tasks by integrating external information.
Graphs provide valuable relational data for RAG applications.
LLMs benefit from GraphRAG in social responsibility and performance.

panels.headline: GraphRAG requires specialized retrievers and generators.
content: Graph data formats vary across domains.
GraphRAG needs multi-hop reasoning and long-form planning.

panels.headline: GraphRAG framework includes query processor, retriever, organizer, generator, and data source.
content: Utilizes graph-based ML and network analysis techniques.
Designs specialized retrievers for complex graph structures.
panels.figure_caption: A holistic framework of GraphRAG and representative techniques for its key components.

panels.headline: GraphRAG applications span social networks, molecular graphs, and hierarchical trees.
content: Drug design, road construction, and academic paper topic prediction.
GraphRAG outperforms conventional RAG in relational knowledge capture.
panels.figure_caption: Publications of GraphRAGs in different domains based on surveyed papers.

panels.headline: GraphRAG shows significant advantages in relational knowledge capture.
content: Specialized retrievers and generators improve multi-hop reasoning and long-form planning.
GraphRAG methods outperform conventional RAG in various tasks.
panels.figure_caption: Summary of Task Applications and Exemplary Queries for GraphRAG in each domain.

panels.headline: GraphRAG is a promising direction for LLMs and RAG.
content: Further research needed for domain-specific GraphRAG techniques.

Fig1.caption: Figure 1: RAG works on text and images, which can be uniformly formatted as 1D sequences or 2D grids with no relational information. In contrast, GraphRAG works on graph-structured data, which encompasses diverse formats and includes domain-specific relational information.
Fig1.description: 对比 RAG 和 GraphRAG 的数据处理方式，强调 GraphRAG 处理图结构数据的能力。
